run_kilt_nq_main: run the Kilt_NQ main function to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_kilt_nq_dataset: create a Kilt_NQ dataset instance to load and preprocess the KILT Natural Questions dataset
load_kilt_nq_dataset: load the KILT Natural Questions dataset from HuggingFace using the load_dataset method
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of input-output tuples with tab-separated answers
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot training, dev, and test splits from the Kilt_NQ dataset with a given seed
